title: Father
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 15.15 Linked Discourses 15.15
  • 2. Dutiyavagga Chapter Two

Pitusutta Father

Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati. At Sāvatthī.

“Anamataggoyaṁ, bhikkhave, saṁsāro …pe… “Mendicants, this transmigration has no known beginning. … na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo napitābhūtapubbo …pe… It’s not easy to find a sentient being who in all this long time has not previously been your father. … alaṁ vimuccitun”ti. This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”

Pañcamaṁ.
